products.name: The Great Gatsby
products.description: F. Scott Fitzgerald's xmasterpiece captures the decadence and excess of the Jazz Age through the eyes of narrator Nick Carraway. Set in the summer of 1922, this timeless classic explores themes of love, wealth, and the American Dream through the tragic story of Jay Gatsby and his obsession with Daisy Buchanan. The novel's beautiful prose and complex characters have made it one of the most celebrated works of American literature.

products.name: To Kill a Mockingbird
products.description: Harper Lee's Pulitzer Prize-winning novel is a gripping tale of racial injustice and childhood innocence in the American South. Through the eyes of Scout Finch, readers witness her father Atticus defend a black man falsely accused of rape in 1930s Alabama. This powerful story addresses themes of morality, prejudice, and the loss of innocence while delivering profound lessons about empathy and standing up for what's right.

George Orwell's dystopian masterpiece presents a chilling vision of a totalitarian future where Big Brother watches everything and the Thought Police punish independent thinking. Winston Smith's struggle against the oppressive regime of Oceania explores themes of surveillance, propaganda, and the power of language. This prophetic novel remains startlingly relevant in our digital age, serving as a warning about the dangers of unchecked government power.

products.name: Pride and Prejudice
products.description: Jane Austen's beloved romance follows the intelligent and spirited Elizabeth Bennet as she navigates the complex social world of Regency England. Her initial prejudice against the proud Mr. Darcy gradually transforms into understanding and love in this witty exploration of marriage, money, and social class. Austen's sharp social commentary and memorable characters have made this novel a timeless favorite among readers worldwide.

products.name: The Catcher in the Rye
products.description: J.D. Salinger's controversial coming-of-age novel follows sixteen-year-old Holden Caulfield as he wanders through New York City after being expelled from prep school. Through Holden's cynical and often humorous observations, the novel explores themes of alienation, identity, and the phoniness of adult society. This influential work has resonated with generations of readers struggling with the transition from adolescence to adulthood.

products.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
products.description: J.K. Rowling's magical debut introduces readers to Harry Potter, an orphaned boy who discovers on his eleventh birthday that he's a wizard. Whisked away to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, Harry learns about his famous past and begins his journey in the wizarding world. This enchanting tale of friendship, courage, and the battle between good and evil launched one of the most beloved fantasy series of all time.

products.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
products.description: J.R.R. Tolkien's epic fantasy masterpiece begins the journey of Frodo Baggins as he inherits the One Ring and must destroy it to save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron. Accompanied by the Fellowship of the Ring, including the wizard Gandalf, the elf Legolas, and the dwarf Gimli, Frodo embarks on a perilous quest. This richly detailed world of hobbits, elves, and magic has influenced countless fantasy works and captivated readers for generations.

products.name: The Hobbit
products.description: Tolkien's charming prelude to The Lord of the Rings follows Bilbo Baggins, a comfortable hobbit who is swept into an unexpected adventure by the wizard Gandalf and thirteen dwarves. Their quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain and its treasure from the dragon Smaug transforms the reluctant Bilbo into a hero. This delightful tale combines humor, adventure, and profound themes about courage and personal growth in a beautifully crafted fantasy world.

products.name: Brave New World
products.description: Aldous Huxley's dystopian novel presents a future society where humans are genetically engineered and conditioned for specific roles, and happiness is maintained through the drug soma. When Bernard Marx and John the Savage challenge this seemingly perfect world, the novel explores themes of individuality, freedom, and the cost of technological progress. This thought-provoking work remains a powerful critique of modern society and the pursuit of artificial happiness.

products.name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
products.description: C.S. Lewis's beloved fantasy novel transports four siblings through a magical wardrobe into the land of Narnia, where they discover a world locked in eternal winter by the White Witch. With the help of the noble lion Aslan, the children must fulfill an ancient prophecy and restore peace to Narnia. This timeless tale weaves together adventure, allegory, and profound themes about sacrifice, redemption, and the triumph of good over evil.

products.name: Dune
products.description: Frank Herbert's science fiction epic is set on the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the universe's most valuable substance, the spice melange. Young Paul Atreides becomes embroiled in a struggle for control of Arrakis and its spice, leading to his transformation into a messianic leader. This complex novel explores themes of politics, religion, ecology, and power while creating one of the most detailed and influential science fiction universes ever conceived.

products.name: The Handmaid's Tale
products.description: Margaret Atwood's dystopian masterpiece depicts the Republic of Gilead, a totalitarian society where women are stripped of their rights and fertile women are forced to bear children for the ruling class. Through the eyes of Offred, a Handmaid, readers experience the horror of a world where fundamentalism has destroyed democracy and individual freedom. This powerful novel serves as both a gripping story and a warning about the fragility of women's rights and democratic institutions.

products.name: The Alchemist
products.description: Paulo Coelho's philosophical novel follows Santiago, a young Andalusian shepherd who dreams of finding treasure in Egypt. His journey becomes a quest for self-discovery as he learns to listen to his heart and follow his personal legend. Through encounters with a king, an alchemist, and the desert itself, Santiago discovers that the real treasure lies not in gold but in the wisdom gained through pursuing one's dreams. This inspiring tale has touched millions of readers worldwide.

products.name: One Hundred Years of Solitude
products.description: Gabriel García Márquez's magical realism masterpiece chronicles seven generations of the Buendía family in the fictional town of Macondo. Blending the fantastical with the mundane, the novel explores themes of solitude, love, power, and the cyclical nature of history. Through the rise and fall of Macondo, Márquez creates an allegory for Latin American history while crafting a deeply human story about the search for meaning and connection in an often absurd world.

products.name: The Kite Runner
products.description: Khaled Hosseini's powerful debut novel tells the story of Amir, a privileged boy from Kabul, and his complex relationship with Hassan, the son of his father's servant. Set against the backdrop of Afghanistan's tumultuous history, the novel explores themes of guilt, redemption, and the enduring power of friendship. When Amir returns to Taliban-controlled Afghanistan to rescue Hassan's son, he confronts his past and seeks to atone for his childhood betrayal.

products.name: The Book Thief
products.description: Markus Zusak's haunting novel is narrated by Death and tells the story of Liesel Meminger, a young girl living with foster parents in Nazi Germany. As Liesel learns to read and discovers the power of words, she begins stealing books and sharing them with others, including a Jewish man hidden in her basement. This beautiful and heartbreaking tale explores the power of literature to provide hope and humanity in the darkest of times.

products.name: Life of Pi
products.description: Yann Martel's extraordinary novel tells the story of Pi Patel, a young Indian boy who survives 227 days stranded on a lifeboat in the Pacific Ocean with a Bengal tiger named Richard Parker. This philosophical adventure explores themes of faith, survival, and the nature of truth as Pi recounts his incredible journey. The novel challenges readers to consider the power of storytelling and the role of belief in making sense of life's most difficult experiences.

products.name: The Da Vinci Code
products.description: Dan Brown's thrilling mystery follows symbologist Robert Langdon as he becomes embroiled in a murder investigation at the Louvre Museum. Teaming up with cryptologist Sophie Neveu, Langdon uncovers a trail of clues hidden in the works of Leonardo da Vinci that lead to a shocking historical secret. This fast-paced novel combines art history, religious symbolism, and conspiracy theories in a page-turning adventure that has captivated millions of readers worldwide.

products.name: The Hunger Games
products.description: Suzanne Collins' dystopian novel is set in a post-apocalyptic nation called Panem, where the Capitol forces children from twelve districts to fight to the death in an annual televised event called the Hunger Games. When sixteen-year-old Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her sister's place in the Games, she becomes a symbol of rebellion against the oppressive regime. This gripping tale explores themes of survival, sacrifice, and the power of individual action against tyranny.

products.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
products.description: Stieg Larsson's gripping thriller introduces Lisbeth Salander, a brilliant but troubled hacker, and Mikael Blomkvist, a disgraced journalist investigating the disappearance of a wealthy industrialist's niece. As they delve deeper into the mystery, they uncover a web of corruption, violence, and family secrets spanning decades. This dark and complex novel combines elements of mystery, crime, and social commentary while creating one of literature's most memorable and unconventional heroines.

products.name: Gone Girl
products.description: Gillian Flynn's psychological thriller explores the dark side of marriage through the story of Nick and Amy Dunne. When Amy disappears on their fifth wedding anniversary, Nick becomes the prime suspect, and the investigation reveals the disturbing truth about their relationship. This twisted tale of deception, manipulation, and revenge challenges readers' assumptions about love, marriage, and the masks people wear. Flynn's masterful storytelling keeps readers guessing until the shocking conclusion.

products.name: The Fault in Our Stars
products.description: John Green's heart-wrenching novel tells the love story of Hazel Grace Lancaster and Augustus Waters, two teenagers who meet at a cancer support group. Despite their illness, they embark on a journey to Amsterdam to meet Hazel's favorite author, discovering the beauty and pain of first love along the way. This poignant tale explores themes of mortality, love, and the search for meaning in the face of tragedy, delivering both laughter and tears in equal measure.

products.name: The Help
products.description: Kathryn Stockett's powerful novel is set in 1960s Mississippi and tells the story of Skeeter, a young white woman who decides to write a book about the experiences of African American maids working for white families. Through the voices of Aibileen and Minny, two courageous maids who agree to share their stories, the novel exposes the injustices of segregation and celebrates the strength of women who dared to speak truth to power during the civil rights era.

products.name: The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time
products.description: Mark Haddon's unique novel is narrated by Christopher, a fifteen-year-old boy with autism who discovers his neighbor's dog has been killed. Determined to solve the mystery, Christopher embarks on an investigation that leads him to uncover family secrets and venture beyond his comfort zone. This touching and insightful story provides a window into the mind of someone with autism while exploring themes of family, truth, and the courage to face the unknown.

products.name: Where the Crawdads Sing
products.description: Delia Owens' atmospheric novel tells the story of Kya Clark, the 'Marsh Girl' who grows up isolated in the marshlands of North Carolina. When a popular local man is found dead, Kya becomes the prime suspect, and the novel alternates between her solitary childhood and the murder investigation. This beautifully written tale combines elements of mystery, romance, and coming-of-age while celebrating the resilience of the human spirit and the healing power of nature.

products.name: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
products.description: Taylor Jenkins Reid's captivating novel tells the story of reclusive Hollywood icon Evelyn Hugo, who finally decides to tell her life story to unknown journalist Monique Grant. As Evelyn recounts her rise to fame and her seven marriages, she reveals the sacrifices she made for love and success in a world that demanded she hide her true self. This glamorous and emotional tale explores themes of ambition, love, and the price of fame while delivering surprising twists and profound truths about identity and authenticity.

products.name: Educated
products.description: Tara Westover's powerful memoir recounts her journey from a survivalist family in rural Idaho to earning a PhD from Cambridge University. Raised by parents who distrusted the government and formal education, Tara didn't set foot in a classroom until she was seventeen. Her pursuit of knowledge transforms her life but comes at the cost of her family relationships. This extraordinary story explores themes of education, family loyalty, and the courage required to forge one's own path.

products.name: Becoming
products.description: Michelle Obama's inspiring memoir chronicles her journey from the South Side of Chicago to the White House and beyond. With warmth and candor, she shares her experiences as a daughter, mother, wife, and First Lady, offering insights into her personal struggles and triumphs. This deeply personal account explores themes of identity, purpose, and the power of education while providing an intimate look at life in the White House and the challenges of public service.

products.name: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
products.description: Yuval Noah Harari's groundbreaking work traces the history of humanity from the emergence of Homo sapiens in Africa to the present day. Harari explores how humans developed language, agriculture, and complex societies, and examines the revolutions that have shaped our species: the Cognitive Revolution, the Agricultural Revolution, and the Scientific Revolution. This thought-provoking book challenges readers to reconsider what they know about human history and our place in the world.

products.name: The Midnight Library
products.description: Matt Haig's philosophical novel follows Nora Seed, who finds herself in a magical library between life and death where each book represents a different life she could have lived. As she explores alternate versions of her existence, Nora grapples with regret, possibility, and the meaning of a life well-lived. This thought-provoking and uplifting story explores themes of mental health, choice, and the infinite possibilities that exist within every life, ultimately celebrating the beauty of human existence.

products.name: Atomic Habits
products.description: James Clear's practical guide reveals how tiny changes can lead to remarkable results. Drawing on scientific research and real-world examples, Clear explains how habits work and provides a proven framework for improving every day. The book shows how small habits compound over time to produce significant outcomes, whether in health, wealth, relationships, or personal development. This actionable guide has helped millions of readers build better habits and break bad ones.

products.name: The Silent Patient
products.description: Alex Michaelides' psychological thriller tells the story of Alicia Berenson, a woman who refuses to speak after allegedly murdering her husband. Psychotherapist Theo Faber becomes obsessed with treating Alicia and uncovering the truth behind her silence. As Theo delves deeper into Alicia's past, he discovers shocking connections to his own life. This gripping novel combines elements of psychological suspense with unreliable narration to create a stunning twist that will leave readers questioning everything they thought they knew.

products.name: Circe
products.description: Madeline Miller's enchanting novel reimagines the story of Circe, the minor goddess from Greek mythology who transforms men into pigs in Homer's Odyssey. Miller gives voice to this complex character, exploring her journey from an awkward nymph to a powerful witch. Through encounters with famous figures like Odysseus, the Minotaur, and Medea, Circe discovers her own strength and finds her place in the world. This beautifully written novel combines mythology with themes of feminism, power, and self-discovery.

products.name: The Testaments
products.description: Margaret Atwood's sequel to The Handmaid's Tale is set fifteen years after Offred's story ends and is narrated by three women whose lives are intertwined with Gilead's fate. Through their perspectives, readers witness the beginning of Gilead's downfall as resistance movements gain strength. This powerful continuation explores themes of resistance, redemption, and the next generation's role in fighting oppression. Atwood's masterful storytelling provides both closure and hope while maintaining the urgency and relevance of the original novel.

products.name: Normal People
products.description: Sally Rooney's acclaimed novel follows the complex relationship between Connell and Marianne from their final year of school in rural Ireland to their undergraduate years at Trinity College Dublin. Despite their deep connection, their relationship is marked by misunderstandings, social pressures, and their own insecurities. This intimate portrait of young love explores themes of class, mental health, and the difficulty of truly knowing another person, capturing the intensity and confusion of coming of age in contemporary Ireland.

products.name: The Vanishing Half
products.description: Brit Bennett's powerful novel tells the story of twin sisters who grow up in a small, southern black community and choose to live in very different worlds. One sister lives with her black daughter in the same southern town she tried to escape, while the other secretly passes for white and her white husband knows nothing of her past. This multigenerational saga explores themes of identity, family, and the long-lasting effects of the choices we make, examining how race shapes our lives in America.

products.name: Klara and the Sun
products.description: Kazuo Ishiguro's haunting novel is narrated by Klara, an Artificial Friend designed to prevent loneliness in children. From her place in a store, Klara observes the world with wonder and develops a deep understanding of human nature. When she's chosen to be a companion for Josie, a sick girl, Klara's devotion leads her to make extraordinary sacrifices. This beautiful and thought-provoking story explores themes of love, sacrifice, and what it means to be human in an age of artificial intelligence.

products.name: The Thursday Murder Club
products.description: Richard Osman's charming mystery introduces four unlikely friends who meet weekly in a retirement village to investigate cold cases. When a real murder occurs in their community, Elizabeth, Joyce, Ibrahim, and Ron find themselves in the middle of their first live case. This delightful novel combines humor, heart, and clever plotting while celebrating the wisdom and vitality of older adults. The engaging characters and intricate mystery make this the perfect cozy crime novel for readers of all ages.

products.name: Project Hail Mary
products.description: Andy Weir's science fiction thriller follows Ryland Grace, who wakes up on a spaceship with no memory of how he got there. As his memories slowly return, he realizes he's humanity's last hope to save Earth from an extinction-level threat. With only an alien companion for help, Grace must use his scientific knowledge to solve an impossible problem. This engaging novel combines hard science with humor and heart, creating a thrilling adventure that celebrates human ingenuity and the power of friendship across species.

products.name: The Invisible Life of Addie LaRue
products.description: V.E. Schwab's enchanting fantasy tells the story of Addie LaRue, who makes a Faustian bargain in 1714 to live forever but is cursed to be forgotten by everyone she meets. For 300 years, Addie lives as a shadow until she meets Henry, a young bookseller in New York who somehow remembers her. This sweeping tale spans centuries and explores themes of memory, identity, and the price of immortality while weaving together romance, magic, and the power of art to transcend time.

products.name: The Guest List
products.description: Lucy Foley's atmospheric thriller is set on a remote Irish island where a glamorous wedding turns deadly. When a body is discovered, everyone becomes a suspect, and the novel reveals the dark secrets and hidden resentments among the wedding party. Told from multiple perspectives, this gripping mystery explores themes of jealousy, revenge, and the facades people maintain. The isolated setting and complex characters create a tense atmosphere that builds to a shocking conclusion.

products.name: The Sanatorium
products.description: Sarah Pearse's debut thriller is set in a remote Swiss Alps hotel that was once a sanatorium. When detective Elin Warner arrives for her brother's engagement party, a snowstorm traps the guests and a woman goes missing. As more people disappear, Elin must confront her own demons while solving the mystery. This atmospheric novel combines elements of psychological suspense with a claustrophobic setting, creating a chilling tale that explores trauma, family secrets, and the thin line between sanity and madness.

products.name: The Four Winds
products.description: Kristin Hannah's epic historical novel is set during the Great Depression and follows Elsa Martinelli, a woman who must make an impossible choice when drought and economic hardship threaten her family's survival in Texas. When she decides to head west to California in search of a better life, Elsa discovers her own strength and resilience. This powerful story explores themes of motherhood, sacrifice, and the American Dream while bringing to life one of the most challenging periods in American history.

products.name: The Midnight Girls
products.description: Alicia Jasinska's dark fantasy reimagines Slavic folklore through the story of three friends who serve the witch Baba Jaga in her chicken-legged house. When they're given an impossible task, Marlinchen, Undine, and Róża must choose between their loyalty to each other and their desire for freedom. This atmospheric novel combines elements of fairy tale, horror, and coming-of-age story while exploring themes of friendship, power, and the price of magic in a beautifully crafted world inspired by Eastern European mythology.

products.name: The Atlas Six
products.description: Olivie Blake's dark academia fantasy follows six young magicians who are recruited to join the prestigious Alexandrian Society, a secret organization that guards lost knowledge of the ancient world. Each candidate possesses unique magical abilities, but only five will be initiated, and one will be eliminated. This complex novel explores themes of power, ambition, and moral ambiguity while creating a richly detailed world where magic and academia intersect in dangerous ways.

products.name: The House in the Cerulean Sea
products.description: TJ Klune's heartwarming fantasy follows Linus Baker, a caseworker for magical children who is sent to investigate an orphanage on a remote island. There he meets six extraordinary children, including the literal Antichrist, and their caretaker Arthur. As Linus learns to see beyond his bureaucratic worldview, he discovers the true meaning of family and home. This uplifting novel celebrates diversity, acceptance, and the power of love to overcome prejudice while delivering humor, heart, and hope in equal measure.

products.name: Mexican Gothic
products.description: Silvia Moreno-Garcia's atmospheric horror novel follows Noemí Taboada, a glamorous socialite who travels to the Mexican countryside to check on her cousin Catalina, who has sent disturbing letters from her new husband's family estate. At High Place, a decaying English manor, Noemí encounters the strange Doyle family and uncovers dark secrets involving eugenics, colonialism, and supernatural horror. This haunting tale combines Gothic atmosphere with social commentary, creating a unique and unsettling reading experience.

products.name: The Priory of the Orange Tree
products.description: Samantha Shannon's epic fantasy is set in a world divided by ancient enmities, where dragons soar and magic flows through the land. The novel follows four women whose destinies become intertwined as an ancient evil awakens: Ead, a dragon-riding warrior; Tané, who dreams of becoming a dragonrider; Queen Sabran, who must secure her bloodline; and Niclays, an alchemist in exile. This sweeping tale combines political intrigue, romance, and dragon lore in a richly imagined world that celebrates female strength and friendship.

products.name: The Poppy War
products.description: R.F. Kuang's dark military fantasy follows Rin, a war orphan who aces the empire-wide test to attend the most elite military school. There she discovers her lethal, unearthly power and is drawn into a world of gods, monsters, and shamanic powers. When war breaks out, Rin must decide how far she's willing to go to save her people. This brutal and unflinching novel explores themes of war, power, and the cost of survival while drawing inspiration from 20th-century Chinese history.

products.name: The Ten Thousand Doors of January
products.description: Alix E. Harrow's portal fantasy follows January Scaller, who discovers a book that tells the story of doors to other worlds. As she reads, January realizes the story is her own, and she must find the courage to open the doors that have been closed to her. This lyrical novel weaves together themes of belonging, identity, and the power of stories while creating a magical world where every door leads to adventure and every story has the power to change reality.
